snippet.title: Launching Two Gold Cubes into Space
snippet.description:
The tiny thrusters kept the satellite centred around a freely falling gold-platinum cube whenever sunlight pushed on it. Engineers call this drag-free operation, and it flips how we normally think about spacecraft navigation upside down.

Out at the Sun Earth L1 Lagrange point, there's no air drag, but solar radiation pressure still shoves the outer hull off course. Capacitive sensors inside the housing tracked each 46-millimetre cube's position down to the nanometre, firing micro Newton thrusters, exerting forces around a few millionths of a Newton, to continuously steer the spacecraft shell so it never touched the floating mass inside.

By acting as an active shield, LISA Pathfinder isolated its test masses from non gravitational forces roughly 10,000 times better than previous drag-free missions, proving that the core hardware for LISA can actually work in deep space.

Republic Bharat LIVE: US Flight Shutdown | Kulgam Terrorist Attack | Rahul | PM Modi | Arnab Goswami

अमेरिका में एयर ट्रैफिक कंट्रोल (ATC) के कम्युनिकेशन सिस्टम में आई बड़ी तकनीकी खराबी के कारण फेडरल एविएशन एडमिनिस्ट्रेशन (FAA) ने शुक्रवार (13 नवंबर 2026) को देशभर में सभी उड़ानों पर रोक (Nationwide Ground Stop) लगा दी थी। 

जम्मू-कश्मीर के कुलगाम जिले में बुधवार (11 नवंबर 2026) को मीर बाजार के पास अखरान (नौपोरा) इलाके में एक CRPF नाके (चेकपोस्ट) पर आतंकी हमला हुआ, जिसमें CRPF के 3 जवान घायल हो गए।

लोकसभा में विपक्ष के नेता राहुल गांधी (Rahul Gandhi) ने 13 नवंबर 2026 को अपना फोन टैप कराए जाने का आरोप लगाते हुए प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी को 'वन-ऑन-वन' सार्वजनिक बहस की चुनौती दी है, जिससे देश की राजनीति में नया घमासान शुरू हो गया है। 

प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने 13 और 14 नवंबर 2026 को कर्नाटक और गुजरात के अपने दो दिवसीय दौरे के दौरान ₹15,600 करोड़ से अधिक की विकास परियोजनाओं का उद्घाटन और शिलान्यास किया है। इसके साथ ही, केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल (Union Cabinet) ने हाल ही में किसानों, उद्यमियों और शहरी बुनियादी ढांचे के लिए ₹77,101 करोड़ के बड़े पैकेज को मंजूरी दी है।

snippet.description:
Every Saturday, David returned to a house that was no longer his home.

Years ago, his little daughter waited by the window, hoping her father would come home. But he was always busy, always working, always promising tomorrow.

Eventually, tomorrow became years.

Then a kind stranger discovered something hidden in the attic—an old drawing and a birthday card that David never knew existed.

What happened next would remind him that sometimes, one small act of kindness can open a door that seemed closed forever.

This is a story about regret, forgiveness, second chances, and the power of never overlooking something that might mean the world to someone else.

전신 방풍우산 / 투명 방풍막 일체형 우산

☂️ 일반적인 우산과 달리 상단의 우산 지붕 아래로 긴 투명 비닐막이 내려오는 구조로, 머리부터 상체와 다리 주변까지 감싸 비바람을 막아주는 독특한 형태의 우산입니다.

🌧️ 우산 위쪽은 일반적인 방수 원단으로 빗물을 막아주고, 측면의 투명 비닐막은 바람을 타고 옆으로 들이치는 빗물이 몸에 직접 닿는 것을 줄여주는 역할을 합니다.

🌬️ 일반 우산은 바람이 강하게 불면 옷이나 바지가 젖기 쉬운데, 전신 방풍우산은 측면까지 비닐막으로 둘러싸는 구조라 옆에서 불어오는 바람과 빗물을 차단하는 데 도움을 줍니다.

👀 측면이 투명한 비닐 소재로 제작돼 내부에서도 주변 풍경을 확인할 수 있으며, 일반적인 불투명 우비와 달리 몸을 감싸면서도 바깥을 볼 수 있다는 점이 특징입니다.

🚶 우산 아래쪽에 사람이 들어갈 수 있는 공간이 마련돼 있어 서 있거나 천천히 이동할 때 활용할 수 있으며, 별도의 우비를 입지 않고도 비바람으로부터 몸을 보호하는 용도로 사용할 수 있습니다.

🏕️ 야외 행사장이나 낚시터, 캠핑장, 비 오는 날의 야외 대기 공간 등에서 활용할 수 있으며, 특히 한자리에서 오랫동안 서 있어야 하는 상황에서 실용적인 방풍·방수 용품이 될 수 있습니다.

특히 평범한 우산처럼 머리 위만 가리는 것이 아니라 투명한 비닐막이 몸 주변까지 길게 내려와 마치 작은 개인용 방풍쉘터 안에 들어가 있는 듯한 모습이 가장 큰 특징입니다.

갑자기 비바람이 강하게 불어오는 날에도 측면에서 들이치는 빗물을 줄일 수 있으며, 투명한 구조 덕분에 외부를 바라보면서 비를 피할 수 있다는 장점이 있습니다.

일반적인 우산과 우비의 특징을 결합한 색다른 형태로, 비 오는 날 야외에서 활동하거나 오랫동안 대기해야 하는 사람들에게 관심을 끌 만한 아이디어 제품입니다.

단, 실제 방풍·방수 효과는 비닐막의 길이와 개방된 부분, 바람의 세기에 따라 달라집니다. 강풍에서는 우산이 뒤집히거나 시야와 움직임이 제한될 수 있으므로 주의해야 하며, 밀폐된 비닐막 내부에서는 적절한 환기가 필요합니다.

snippet.title: 羅大佑說台灣不敢講話？在台灣罵最大聲，在中國最安靜 #勇哥大聲公
snippet.description:
羅大佑說民進黨讓台灣人不敢發聲。那就用他自己 1991 年講過的話，來對一下他的勇氣帳。

本集重點
・1991 年他在香港電台《鏗鏘集》說：「當大家都不敢表達自己，有一個人便會特別大聲，這個人就是專制者」
・2019 年 6 月他在台北小巨蛋唱〈皇后大道東〉，三次強調「有些事情真的不能那麼急」
・四天後網友發現這首歌在 QQ 音樂、網易雲、酷狗、蝦米都搜不到，〈東方之珠〉也在 QQ 音樂下架
・經紀人回應：歌常被拿來呼應時事，「與他最初創作歌曲的精神沒有直接關聯」，「沒有什麼要特別回應的」
・之後香港清場、新疆再教育營、中國網路喊血洗台灣，找不到他再公開講過一句；2025 年還宣布要到杭州奧體中心開唱
・在台灣他是最大聲的那個，在中國他是最安靜的那個

snippet.title: The Pump That Pushes Water Uphill With No Power
snippet.description:
A hydraulic ram pump uses the momentum of falling water to lift part of it higher than its source, with no external power. Water speeds up down a drive pipe until the flow slams the waste (impulse) valve shut. The sudden stop (water hammer) forces water through a one-way delivery valve into an air chamber, and the compressed air pushes it up a narrow delivery pipe. When the pressure drops, the waste valve reopens and the cycle repeats, typically about once a second. Most of the water leaves through the waste valve; a small fraction is delivered, and lift heights of up to roughly ten times the fall are commonly quoted.

John Whitehurst built a hand-operated precursor in 1772. Joseph-Michel Montgolfier, co-inventor of the hot-air balloon, built the first self-acting ram in 1796 to raise water for his paper mill at Voiron; Matthew Boulton took out the British patent on his behalf in 1797.

snippet.title: Don Rufino lleva 10 años sin hablarle a su hermano 😔 Doña Chuy le dio este consejo #abuela
snippet.description:
Don Rufino llegó con flores a la cocina de Doña Chuy, pero traía algo más pesado: diez años sin hablarle a su hermano Anastasio por una cerca que se movió medio metro. Mientras cocinaba su cocido de res, Doña Chuy le contó lo que le pasó a su compadre Genovevo y le dijo cómo dar el primer paso: no con una discusión, sino con un plato de comida caliente.
💬 Y tú, ¿perdonarías a tu hermano? Dime SÍ o NO en los comentarios.


🍲 RECETA: COCIDO DE RES CON GARBANZO
Rinde: 6 porciones
Ingredientes:
1 kg de chambarete de res con hueso
1 taza de garbanzos remojados desde la noche anterior
3 zanahorias en rodajas
2 chayotes en cubos
2 elotes en rodajas gruesas
3 papas en cuartos
¼ de col en gajos
½ cebolla y 3 dientes de ajo
3 litros de agua
Sal al gusto (empieza con 1 cucharada)
Hierbabuena y limón para servir
Preparación:
Pon la carne, los garbanzos, la cebolla y el ajo en la olla con el agua. Cuece a fuego medio unas 2 horas (40 minutos en olla exprés), quitando la espuma.
Agrega la sal y las zanahorias. Cocina 15 minutos.
Agrega las papas, los chayotes y los elotes. Cocina 15 minutos más.
Agrega la col los últimos 10 minutos.
Sirve caliente con hierbabuena y un chorrito de limón.

🧡 Enseñanza: el orgullo te deja con la razón y sin hermano. Haz las paces antes de que sea tarde.

snippet.title: Why WW1 Tunnelers Dug Lying on a Wooden Cross
snippet.description:
Under the trenches of WW1 there was a second war, fought in total silence. Clay kickers lay on a wooden cross and pushed a spade into the clay with their feet, because a pick could be heard through the earth, while listeners with geophones tracked the enemy tunnel coming the other way. Whoever was heard first got buried; a small charge called a camouflet could collapse the enemy gallery without breaking the ground above.

snippet.title: What If Your Muscles Switched Off For 5 Seconds
snippet.description:
Ever wonder why your human skeleton cannot stand alone? Discover the role of muscles in keeping you upright.

Your skeletal system is held together by over 600 muscles that make up 40 percent of your total body weight. Without this constant support, your frame would collapse because bones alone lack the stability required for posture. When these muscles switch off, the head and body fall uncontrolled, demonstrating how we rely on internal mechanics to defy gravity.

Understanding this body weight distribution explains why movement is a complex coordination of biological systems. By analyzing how these structures interact, we can see why a person would collapse immediately if these tissues failed to function. This breakdown highlights the essential relationship between our frame and the soft tissue that keeps us standing.

📍 Concept: Anatomy and body stability
